jira.description: Jira issue tracking — search, create, update, comment, transition issues

_comments.usage: Copy this server to your ~/.claude.json (or project .mcp.json) mcpServers section to enable /jira
_comments.env_vars: Replace YOUR_*_HERE placeholders with actual values, or set JIRA_URL/JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN as environment variables instead
